full_judgment: 5. Question raised in this Rule is, whether arbitrator can pass an ad-interim order in a dispute case under sections 86-87 of the said Ordinance. Sections 86 and 87 of the Ordinance empowers the Registrar or an officer appointed by him to dispose of the dispute case subject to the Rules. Under section 88 of the Ordinance the Registrar can pass an award in respect of immoveable property which will have the effect of a final mortgage decree of the civil Court. Under section 89 of the Ordinance in case of any complicated question of law and fact involved in the dispute, Registrar may stay the proceedings of the dispute case and refer the case to the District Judge for decision. Excepting the power of stay of a dispute case under section 89 of the Ordinance Registrar or an officer appointed by him has no other power of stay under the Ordinance.
